Retains Pcal DNA processing, residue and cluster-context effects separately from Gsu fusion/Cas2 reconstitution and E.coli surrogate-cell acquisition. SSO0001 current PF12705, source contradictions, native function and remaining member coverage are explicit limits; IN_PROGRESS, no publication or family-wide completion.

evidence.explanation: Pcal endonuclease Methods lists Mg while Results describes Mn; the exact panel assignment needs clarification.
ED4g caption contradicts Results on Pfu-PAM integration; Table1 and Methods also differ on pET28 vector naming.

discussions.notes: Preserve ED4g contradiction, pET28a/b discrepancy, unresolved tag scars and inaccessible Pcal supplement. No successful cellular PAM-switch edge or exclusive metal requirement is adopted.
discussions.prompt: Resolve assay-metal, vector and cellular-PAM-switch discrepancies against primary material.
discussions.rationale: Conditional experimental effects are supported, but conflicting source statements cannot be silently normalized.

evidence.explanation: Native Pcal partners and CRISPR versus non-CRISPR role are unresolved.
Gsu fusion/Cas2 and E.coli ExoI reconstitution does not identify the native Gsu trimming nuclease.

discussions.notes: See evidence/PF01930/coverage.txt for B.halodurans mapping, Thermoproteus paralogs, Pyrococcus, Synechocystis, MbCas4/1, DNA2 and later studies. SSO0001 now maps PF12705; SSO1391 is a distinct comparator, not Pcal evidence.
discussions.prompt: Extend accession-mapped primary review to remaining Cas4 and DNA2 members and native biological contexts.
